name: The Lewdest House
source:
Lincoln, the middle brother of 10 sisters, decides to build up courage to finally confess to his crush before summer starts.
But sadly, this summer starts with bad news… but also new opportunities, in special when he learns some secrets his sisters had and never shared with him until now.

[From the [url=https://cathornerogames.com/the-lewdest-house/]official website[/url]]
translation:
林肯是10个姐妹中的中间兄弟，他决定鼓起勇气，在夏天到来之前最终向自己暗恋的对象表白。
但可悲的是，今年夏天开始有坏消息……但也有新的机会，特别是当他得知他的姐妹们拥有的一些秘密，直到现在才与他分享。

[摘自[url=https://cathornerogames.com/the-lewdest-house/]官方网站[/url]]
